patterns.name: Ask, don’t gather
patterns.desc: Instead of opening six tabs before a call, ask for the brief.

patterns.name: Pull live, don’t paste
patterns.desc: Instead of pasting CRM notes into Claude, let it pull them live, so nothing goes stale.

patterns.name: Be specific, not general
patterns.desc: Instead of “How’s my pipeline?”, ask a question with a filter, a time window and a signal.

roles.name: Account executive
roles.tagline: Prep, follow-up and deal strategy, without the tab hunt.

groups.title: Before the call
groups.heading: Ask for the brief. Let it pull live.

swaps.title: Pre-call prep
swaps.instead: Opening six tabs before a call: CRM, inbox, calendar and last week’s recording.
swaps.ask: Brief me on Vantage Retail: last three meetings, open risks, anyone who’s gone quiet.
swaps.why: One ask replaces the hunt, and every line comes from captured activity.

swaps.title: Deal updates
swaps.instead: Pasting CRM notes into Claude and hoping they’re current.
swaps.ask: Using Backstory, what’s changed on Vantage Retail since last Tuesday?
swaps.why: It pulls the record live, so nothing goes stale.

groups.title: Sharpen the question
groups.heading: Add a filter, a time window and a signal

swaps.title: Pipeline check
swaps.ask: Which of my deals closing this quarter have no exec contact in 30 days?
swaps.why: A filter, a time window and a signal turn a vague answer into a to-do list.

swaps.title: Stakeholder map
swaps.instead: Rebuilding the buying group from memory.
swaps.ask: Who at Vantage Retail have we met with in the last 90 days, and who’s missing from the buying group?
swaps.why: See who’s engaged and who’s missing, based on real meetings.

swaps.title: Deal risk
swaps.ask: What are the top three risks on the Vantage Retail opportunity, and what’s the evidence for each?
swaps.why: Asking for evidence ties each risk to a real meeting or email.

groups.title: After the call
groups.heading: Start from what’s captured, not from memory

swaps.title: Follow-up email
swaps.instead: Copying meeting notes into an email and rewriting them as a recap.
swaps.ask: Using Backstory, draft a follow-up to my last Vantage Retail meeting with the next steps we agreed.
swaps.why: The meeting is already captured. Start from it, not from memory.

mock.title: Draft
mock.subject: Next steps from Tuesday’s demo
mock.body: Thanks for the time, Jordan. As agreed: revised pricing by Friday, security review kickoff next week, and a working session with your ops team on the 14th.

swaps.title: Precedent
swaps.instead: Asking around Slack for someone who’s closed a deal like this.
swaps.ask: Find a similar deal to Vantage Retail and tell me how it was won.
swaps.why: Situation search finds comparable past deals. Available where your workspace has it enabled.

roles.name: Sales manager
roles.tagline: Forecasts, 1:1s and coaching, grounded in what reps actually did.

groups.title: The weekly rhythm
groups.heading: Swap the prep behind every standing meeting

swaps.title: Coaching focus
swaps.instead: Coaching from gut feel on who’s struggling.
swaps.ask: Which reps have deals with no customer meeting in the last 21 days?
swaps.why: Meeting gaps captured in Backstory show where coaching matters most.

swaps.title: 1:1 prep
swaps.instead: Asking the rep to walk through every deal.
swaps.ask: Before my 1:1 with Priya, summarize her top five deals: recent activity, risks and next steps.
swaps.why: The 1:1 starts at the conversation, not the status update.

swaps.title: Forecast prep
swaps.instead: Exporting the pipeline to a spreadsheet before the forecast call.
swaps.ask: Using Backstory, which deals in my team’s commit changed stage or close date this week?
swaps.why: You walk in knowing what moved, without rebuilding the view.

groups.title: Inspect with structure
groups.heading: Give the answer a framework you can coach against

swaps.title: Deal inspection
swaps.ask: Evaluate the Halden Freight opportunity using MEDDPICC and flag the gaps.
swaps.why: A framework turns “I think so” into specific gaps to close.
swaps.note: Swap in the methodology your team uses, such as MEDDIC, BANT, SPICED or Challenger.

groups.title: See across the team
groups.heading: Let patterns surface, instead of hunting for them

swaps.title: At-risk accounts
swaps.instead: Reading every call summary to find the accounts going cold.
swaps.ask: Which accounts on my team have gone quiet in the last 30 days, ranked by deal size?
swaps.why: Ranking by size tells you where to look first.

swaps.title: Win patterns
swaps.instead: Relying on anecdotes for what’s working.
swaps.ask: Across deals my team won last quarter, what did the buying groups have in common?
swaps.why: Scoped to one quarter and one team, the pattern is specific enough to act on.

roles.name: Customer success
roles.tagline: Handoffs, renewals and expansion, with the full account story on hand.

groups.title: One account, four moments
groups.heading: Corvia Health, from handoff to expansion

swaps.title: Sales handoff
swaps.instead: A 30-minute handoff call to learn what was promised.
swaps.ask: Summarize what was promised to Corvia Health during the sales cycle: goals, commitments and open questions.
swaps.why: Commitments made in meetings don’t get lost between teams.

swaps.title: QBR prep
swaps.instead: Building the QBR deck from a blank page.
swaps.ask: Draft a QBR outline for Corvia Health from this quarter’s meetings and emails.
swaps.why: Start from what the customer actually said this quarter.

swaps.title: Renewal prep
swaps.instead: Piecing the renewal story together the week before.
swaps.ask: Using Backstory, summarize Corvia Health’s last 90 days: meetings, open issues and renewal risks.
swaps.why: The story is already in the activity. Ask for it early.

swaps.title: Expansion
swaps.ask: Which teams at Corvia Health have we met with outside the original buying group this quarter?
swaps.why: New conversations outside the core team are the earliest expansion signal.

groups.title: Catch signals early
groups.heading: See the drop-off while there’s time to act

swaps.title: Quiet contacts
swaps.instead: Finding out your champion left when an email bounces.
swaps.ask: Which contacts at Corvia Health used to be active and have gone quiet?
swaps.why: You see the drop-off while there’s still time to act.

swaps.title: Book health
swaps.instead: Scanning your book account by account.
swaps.ask: Which of my accounts renewing in the next 90 days have had no meeting in 45 days?
swaps.why: Two filters turn a whole book into a short list.
